sentences.zh: 他们在那些年里向早期州的选民陈述了他们的主张。

sentences.en: And they made their case to the voters in the early states.
sentences.zh: 通过卡特在艾奥瓦州获得第一名，以及克林顿在新罕布什尔州表现超出预期，他们推动自己赢得了提名。

sentences.en: And by Carter finishing first in Iowa and Clinton doing better than expected in New Hampshire, they propelled themselves towards winning the nomination.
sentences.zh: 他们推动自己赢得了提名。

sentences.en: That path doesn't really exist in this cycle because without the broad donor network, you're not going to appear in the debates that voters in the early states are watching.
sentences.zh: 在这个周期里，那条路其实根本走不通，因为如果没有广泛的捐款人网络，你就无法出现在选民们正在关注的早期州辩论中。

sentences.en: So are you saying that Jimmy Carter, Bill Clinton, under this set of qualifications, they wouldn't be president and maybe they wouldn't even make it to the next debate?
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，如果按照这套资格标准，吉米·卡特和比尔·克林顿可能连总统都当不上，甚至可能连下一场辩论都进不去？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's a real advantage, almost insurmountable, in being a national candidate or candidate with a national brand.
sentences.zh: 成为一名全国性候选人，或者拥有全国性品牌的候选人，确实有着巨大的、几乎无法逾越的优势。

sentences.en: Do you think that Tom Perez would have predicted that the consequences of this qualification would be so dramatic?
sentences.zh: 你认为汤姆·佩雷斯当初预料到这种资格标准会导致如此戏剧性的后果吗？

sentences.en: And do you think he would see it as a good thing?
sentences.zh: 而且你觉得他会认为这是件好事吗？

sentences.en: I think Tom Perez understood that it would be too unwieldy to have two dozen candidates competing for debate slots well into the fall and winter.
sentences.zh: 我认为汤姆·佩雷斯明白，让二十多名候选人一直竞争辩论名额到秋季和冬季，会显得过于臃肿。

sentences.en: I don't know that he anticipated the sort of mass panhandling in order to qualify for the debates that we've seen from these candidates over the summer.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道他是否预料到了，为了获得辩论资格，这些候选人在整个夏天表现出的那种大规模乞讨捐款的行为。

sentences.en: And perhaps the impact it would have on the place of the early states, Iowa and New Hampshire.
sentences.zh: 以及这可能对爱荷华州和新罕布什尔州这些早期州地位产生的影响。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because I don't think anyone quite understood it at the time that that's what would happen.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得当时没人完全意识到会发生这种情况。

sentences.en: And as the early states have lost some of their power over culling the field and choosing the nominee, you know, because politics like nature abhors a vacuum,
sentences.zh: 随着早期州在筛选候选人和选择提名人方面的权力有所减弱，你知道，因为政治就像自然界一样厌恶真空，

sentences.en: that power has shifted to the cable networks and the national media, which is the second big change in this process.
sentences.zh: 这种权力已经转移到了有线电视网络和全国性媒体手中，这是这个过程中第二个重大变化。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能让你免费试用一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《纽约时报》的订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载时报应用，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: You know, in the old days, the powers that helped determine and shape these races were the local newspapers,
sentences.zh: 你知道，在过去，那些有助于决定和塑造这些竞选格局的力量是当地报纸，

sentences.en: places like the Des Moines Register or the City Rapids Gazette or the Quad City Times.
sentences.zh: 比如《得梅因纪事报》、《锡达拉皮兹公报》或《四城时报》这样的地方媒体。

sentences.en: Now that power has shifted.
sentences.zh: 现在，这种权力已经转移了。

sentences.en: I am very pleased to say, joining us now for the interview is Pete Buttigieg.
sentences.zh: 我非常高兴地宣布，现在加入我们访谈的是皮特·布蒂吉格。

sentences.en: He is the mayor of South Bend, Indiana, and now officially a candidate for president in the Democratic primary.
sentences.zh: 他是印第安纳州南本德市的市长，现在正式成为民主党初选的总统候选人。

sentences.en: I'm joined now by Democratic Senator and 2020 presidential candidate Amy Klobuchar of Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 现在加入我的是来自明尼苏达州的民主党参议员、2020年总统候选人艾米·克洛布查尔。

sentences.en: Back with us now is former HUD Secretary Julian Castro, who is now running in the Democratic presidential primary.
sentences.zh: 现在回到我们节目的是前住房和城市发展部部长朱利安·卡斯特罗，他目前正在参加民主党总统初选。

sentences.en: Mr. Secretary, thank you again.
sentences.zh: 部长先生，再次感谢您。

sentences.en: Great to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: Coming right now is Senator Cory Booker of New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 接下来要登场的是来自新泽西州的科里·布克参议员。

sentences.en: Thank you for coming on, Senator.
sentences.zh: 感谢您的到来，参议员。

sentences.en: To Rachel Maddow and Chris Matthews.
sentences.zh: 致蕾切尔·麦多和克里斯·马修斯。

sentences.en: And that has really changed how the campaigns operate and, frankly, how the whole race operates.
sentences.zh: 这确实改变了竞选活动的运作方式，坦率地说，也改变了整个选战的运作方式。

sentences.en: I don't know much about your national security background, but I do want to just get your response
sentences.zh: 我对你的国家安全背景了解不多，但我确实想听听你的回应，

sentences.en: to this current controversy that's happening, this standoff that's happening now between Democrats and Congress.
sentences.zh: 针对目前正在发生的争议，也就是现在国会民主党人之间的僵局。

sentences.en: You know, there's not a focus on state-level issues that you typically see.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们不再像往常那样关注州级议题了。

sentences.en: When you took that comment there about how it's not enough to beat Trump, that sounded like a shot at Vice President Biden.
sentences.zh: 你刚才那番关于“击败特朗普是不够的”评论，听起来像是在针对拜登副总统。

sentences.en: No, I've been saying it since I got in.
sentences.zh: 不，我从参选开始就一直这么说。

sentences.en: I got in this race.
sentences.zh: 我参加了这场竞选。

sentences.en: Well, who are you talking about if not him?
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果不是他，你在说谁？

sentences.en: This is the theme of my campaign since we kicked it off.
sentences.zh: 这是我竞选活动自启动以来的主题。

sentences.en: I can't remember a race in Iowa that didn't have some sort of discussion about the renewable fuel standard, which is sort of an arcane federal law involving soybeans,
sentences.zh: 我不记得爱荷华州有哪次竞选不讨论可再生燃料标准，这是一种涉及大豆的晦涩联邦法律，

sentences.en: that isn't discussed at all anymore in the campaign because national television doesn't care about it.
sentences.zh: 现在竞选中根本没人讨论它了，因为全国性电视台根本不在乎这个。

sentences.en: Wait, wait, wait.
sentences.zh: 等等，等等，等等。

sentences.en: I'm going to test your local expertise here.
sentences.zh: 我要测试一下你对当地情况的了解。

sentences.en: I believe that involves ethanol and corn, not soybeans.
sentences.zh: 我相信那涉及的是乙醇和玉米，而不是大豆。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'll lose my Midwest street cred for that.
sentences.zh: 我会因为这个失去我在中西部的信誉了。

sentences.en: I know you meant corn.
sentences.zh: 我知道你指的是玉米。

sentences.en: It's because they haven't brought it up.
sentences.zh: 那是因为他们没提过。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's because the current political environment has discouraged your local knowledge.
sentences.zh: 那是因为当前的政治环境已经让你们的本土知识变得无用武之地。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: The media landscape is to blame.
sentences.zh: 媒体环境该背锅。

sentences.en: For all of our probleMs.
sentences.zh: 背负我们所有的问题。

sentences.en: I had a conversation with a campaign manager for one of the leading tier campaigns in Iowa last month.
sentences.zh: 上个月，我和爱荷华州一家领先竞选团队的经理谈过。

sentences.en: And the campaign manager told me that every time his candidate is on Rachel Maddow, they see a significant bump in their online fundraising.
sentences.zh: 那位竞选经理告诉我，每当他的候选人出现在蕾切尔·麦多的节目上，他们的在线筹款额就会显著增长。

sentences.en: There is a direct correlation to candidates appearing on these shows.
sentences.zh: 候选人上这些节目与筹款之间存在直接关联。

sentences.en: And not just the amount of money that they bring in for their campaigns, but the number of donors, which has become far more important this cycle than it ever has before.
sentences.zh: 这不仅关乎他们为竞选筹集的资金总额，还关乎捐款人数，这在本届竞选中变得比以往任何时候都重要。

sentences.en: So in order to build that national base and get the number of donors to stay in these debates, the incentive will be to focus on national media,
sentences.zh: 因此，为了建立全国性的支持基础并获得足够的捐款人数以留在辩论台上，激励机制将是专注于全国性媒体，

sentences.en: which inevitably probably means being in a studio in Washington or New York rather than in a bar in Iowa.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他们不可避免地更倾向于待在华盛顿或纽约的演播室，而不是爱荷华州的酒吧里。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so it's a television-driven campaign more than it is a person-to-person campaign.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一场电视驱动的竞选，而不是一场面对面的竞选。

sentences.en: And television just has different priorities than regular people do.
sentences.zh: 而电视的优先事项与普通人完全不同。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: We are just moments away from the first draw.
sentences.zh: 距离第一轮抽签还有几分钟时间。

sentences.en: When 10 candidates, half of the field, are going to be assigned a debate night in the first draw, you'll see it all in real time.
sentences.zh: 届时将有10位候选人，也就是半数参赛者，被分配到第一场辩论之夜，你们将实时看到这一切。

sentences.en: We'll have the first draw after a quick break.
sentences.zh: 稍事休息后，我们将进行第一轮抽签。

sentences.en: Being interesting for television is a different standard than, you know, being an attractive candidate for 50 people who might show up to see you at an Elks Lodge in Sioux City.
sentences.zh: 对于电视来说，追求“有趣”的标准，与在苏城麋鹿会所里吸引那50个来看你的选民，是完全不同的标准。

sentences.en: And so all of that leads us to the third big change, which is the formats of the debates and the incentive structures built into the debates.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切把我们引向了第三个重大变化，即辩论的格式以及辩论中内置的激励结构。

sentences.en: We're about to begin opening statements, but first a review of the ground rules that your campaigns agreed to earlier this month to ensure a fair debate.
sentences.zh: 我们即将开始开场陈述，但首先回顾一下你们的竞选团队在本月初商定的基本规则，以确保辩论公平。

sentences.en: 160 years ago, you had Stephen Douglas and Abraham Lincoln going back and forth in 15-minute segments.
sentences.zh: 160年前，斯蒂芬·道格拉斯和亚伯拉罕·林肯进行过15分钟一轮的辩论。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Now...
sentences.zh: 现在……

sentences.en: You will each receive one minute to answer questions, 30 seconds for responses and rebuttals, and 15 additional seconds if a moderator asks for a clarification.
sentences.zh: 你们每人将获得一分钟时间回答问题，30秒用于回应和反驳，如果主持人要求澄清，还可以额外获得15秒。

sentences.en: They get questions and they can respond for 60 seconds at a time, or if someone is doing a rebuttal or a follow-up, they get 30 seconds,
sentences.zh: 他们得到问题，每次可以回应60秒，或者如果有人进行反驳或追问，他们有30秒，

sentences.en: or when chaos breaks up, they sort of all speak over each other.
sentences.zh: 或者当场面陷入混乱时，他们基本上都在互相抢话。

sentences.en: As the youngest guy on the stage, I feel like I probably ought to contribute to the generational conversation.
sentences.zh: 作为台上最年轻的人，我觉得我应该为代际对话做出贡献。

sentences.en: It's part of Joe's generation.
sentences.zh: 这是乔那一代人的部分。

sentences.en: But in none of those instances do the candidates have a terribly long time to speak to people and make their points.
sentences.zh: 但在所有这些情况下，候选人都没有太多的时间来与人们交流并阐述他们的观点。

sentences.en: It's good health insurance, and it's not nearly enough.
sentences.zh: 这是很好的医疗保险，但还远远不够。

sentences.en: Senator, I'm staying with you.
sentences.zh: 参议员，我还是问你。

sentences.en: I'm staying with you, but you exceeded your time.
sentences.zh: 我还是问你，但你超时了。

sentences.en: And all of these candidates on stage have thoughtful positions on almost every topic that is being discussed,
sentences.zh: 台上所有的候选人对几乎每一个正在讨论的话题都有深思熟虑的立场，

sentences.en: but they don't get a chance to exhibit that during these debates because of the way the format is arranged.
sentences.zh: 但由于辩论格式的安排，他们没有机会在辩论中展示这一点。

sentences.en: I have a better path.
sentences.zh: 我有一条更好的路。

sentences.en: Medicare for America.
sentences.zh: “全民医保”。

sentences.en: Everyone who's uninsured is enrolled in Medicare tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 所有没有保险的人明天就加入医保。

sentences.en: Those who are insufficiently insured are enrolled in Medicare.
sentences.zh: 那些保险不足的人也加入医保。

sentences.en: 5 to 15 seconds.
And those who have employer-sponsored insurance.
sentences.zh: 还有那些拥有雇主提供保险的人。

sentences.en: Jake, this is important.
sentences.zh: 杰克，这很重要。

sentences.en: You know, somebody like Beto O'Rourke, who is a very compelling political figure when he's doing campaign events and he speaks in five- or six-minute explanations for his points,
sentences.zh: 你知道，像贝托·奥罗克这样的人，他在参加竞选活动时非常有政治感染力，他会用五六分钟的时间来解释他的观点，

sentences.en: has struggled in these debates to condense what he's saying into 30 and 60 seconds.
sentences.zh: 但在这些辩论中，他却很难将自己的话压缩到30秒或60秒内。

sentences.en: And you can tell by watching.
sentences.zh: 你看的时候就能看出来。

sentences.en: You have others to my right who are talking about taking away people's choice for the private insurance they have or members of unions.
sentences.zh: 我右边的其他人正在谈论剥夺人们选择现有私人保险的权利，或者剥夺工会成员的权利。

sentences.en: I was listening to D.
sentences.zh: 我当时正在听D·泰勒在内华达州的讲话。

sentences.en: Taylor in Nevada.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，国会议员。

sentences.en: Thank you, Congressman.
sentences.zh: 让我请出布洛克州长。

sentences.en: Let me bring you Governor Bullock.
sentences.zh: 他刚才说你在提供一个虚假的选项，先生。

sentences.en: He just said you're offering a false choice, sir.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，很难在实时表达中编辑自己的语言。

sentences.en: That it's hard for him to sort of edit himself in real time in what he's trying to say.
sentences.zh: 对于电视网来说，这些活动就是摇钱树。

sentences.en: For the networks, these events are cash cows.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切的激励方向都是朝着……

sentences.en: And so the incentives for all of this are toward...
sentences.zh: 在你的计划下，维持现状，你什么都不做来追究保险公司的责任……

sentences.en: Under your plan, status quo, you do nothing to hold the insurance companies to task...
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是奇观，更是冲突。

sentences.en: Not just spectacle, but conflict.
sentences.zh: 副总统先生，我们社区有句谚语，你喝着酷爱饮料，却连是什么味道都不知道。

sentences.en: Mr. Vice President, there's a saying in my community, you're dipping into the Kool-Aid and you don't even know the flavor.
sentences.zh: 你需要来到……市。

sentences.en: You need to come to the city of...
sentences.zh: 这将取决于哪位候选人制造了最精彩的瞬间，这些瞬间在随后的几天里会被更多人在有线电视和Facebook信息流中看到。

sentences.en: It'll be about which candidate has developed the best moments that are seen by more people in the days after on cable television and in people's Facebook feeds.
sentences.zh: 全民医保是全面的。

sentences.en: Medicare for all is comprehensive.
sentences.zh: 它涵盖了所有的医疗需求。

sentences.en: It covers all health care needs.
sentences.zh: 对于老年人来说，它最终将包括牙科护理、助听器和眼镜。

sentences.en: For senior citizens, it will finally include dental care, hearing aids, and eyeglasses.
sentences.zh: 但你不知道这一点。

sentences.en: But you don't know that.
sentences.zh: 第二点。

sentences.en: Second of all.
sentences.zh: 你不知道这一点，伯尼。

sentences.en: You don't know that, Bernie.
sentences.zh: 第二点。

sentences.en: Second of all.
sentences.zh: 我们一会儿再找你，国会议员。

sentences.en: We'll come to you in a second, Congressman.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I do know.
sentences.zh: 而且那该死的法案就是我写的。

sentences.en: And I wrote the damn bill.
sentences.zh: 我最近为一个故事采访了一位《单身汉》节目的前制作人，她说，

sentences.en: I talked for a story recently with a woman who had been a producer on The Bachelor who said,
sentences.zh: 你知道，这非常像早期的剧集，当时有很多候选人或参赛者，

sentences.en: you know, it's very much like the early episodes where you have a lot of candidates or contestants
sentences.zh: 在开始淘汰他们之前，观众根本没时间了解他们所有人。

sentences.en: and the audience doesn't have time to learn about all of them before you start weeding them out.
sentences.zh: 只有到了最后，观众才会对节目中幸存下来的角色产生某种好感或了解。

sentences.en: And only toward the end does the audience sort of develop sort of an affection or knowledge of the characters who have survived to that point in the show.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 这种隐喻表明，冲突在过程中是受欢迎和被鼓励的。

sentences.en: And that metaphor suggests that conflict is welcomed and encouraged along the way.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，有线电视网络在这些辩论中搜寻冲突。

sentences.en: There's no question that the cable networks are trolling for conflict in these debates.
sentences.zh: 希肯卢珀州长，你发了一条Facebook广告，警告说，引用：“社会主义不是答案。”

sentences.en: Governor Hickenlooper, you ran a Facebook ad that warned, quote, socialism is not the answer.
sentences.zh: 广告还说，引用：“别让极端主义再给特朗普四年时间。”

sentences.en: The ad also said, quote, don't let extremes give Trump four more years.
sentences.zh: 你是说桑德斯参议员太极端，无法击败特朗普总统吗？

sentences.en: Are you saying that Senator Sanders is too extreme to beat President Trump?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是为什么他们会说，比如你说过这位候选人的立场是错误的。

sentences.en: I mean, that's why they'll say, like, you've said that this other candidate's position is wrong.
sentences.zh: 你为什么这么认为？

sentences.en: Why do you think that?
sentences.zh: 加巴德众议员，你对哈里斯参议员在上场辩论中与拜登副总统对质表示不满。

sentences.en: Congresswoman Gabbard, you took issue with Senator Harris confronting Vice President Biden at the last debate.
sentences.zh: 你称其为，引用：“乔·拜登是种族主义者的虚假指控。”

sentences.en: You called it a, quote, false accusation that Joe Biden is a raciSt.
sentences.zh: 你的回应是什么？

sentences.en: What's your response?
sentences.zh: 我想把话题带回到破碎的刑事司法系统上来。

sentences.en: I want to bring the conversation back to the broken criminal justice system.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是CNN本周向这些候选人提出的每个问题的设定。

sentences.en: That's essentially the setup for every question that CNN is posing to these candidates this week.
sentences.zh: 她曾因大麻违规将1500多人送进监狱，当被问及她是否吸过大麻时，她却对此一笑置之。

sentences.en: She put over 1,500 people in jail for marijuana violations and then laughed about it when she was asked if she ever smoked marijuana.
sentences.zh: 试图让他们相互互动并形成对比。

sentences.en: To try to get them to interact and contrast with each other.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，众议员。

sentences.en: Thank you, Congresswoman.
sentences.zh: 哈里斯参议员，你的回应？

sentences.en: Senator Harris, your response?
sentences.zh: 我整个职业生涯中，个人一直反对死刑，这一点从未改变。

sentences.en: My entire career, I have been opposed, personally opposed to the death penalty, and that has never changed.
sentences.zh: 制造一种情况，出现某种修辞上的火花，创造一个会被反复重播的时刻，

sentences.en: To develop a situation where there's some sort of rhetorical fireworks that will create a moment that will be replayed over and over again,
sentences.zh: 不仅是为了候选人，也是为了其他报道辩论的电视网，让他们反复播放CNN的画面。

sentences.en: not just for the candidates, but for the other networks that are reporting on the debate to replace CNN's footage over and over again.
sentences.zh: 加巴德，请继续。

sentences.en: Gabbard, back in.
sentences.zh: 你的回应？

sentences.en: Your response?
sentences.zh: 底线是，哈里斯参议员，当你身处能够改变和影响这些人生活的位置时，你并没有这样做。

sentences.en: The bottom line is, Senator Harris, when you were in a position to make a difference and an impact in these people's lives, you did not.
sentences.zh: 底线是，哈里斯参议员，当你身处能够改变和影响这些人生活的位置时，你并没有这样做。

sentences.en: And worse yet, in the case of those who were on death row, innocent people, you actually blocked evidence from being revealed that would have freed them.
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，对于那些死囚，那些无辜的人，你实际上阻挠了本可以让他们重获自由的证据被披露。

sentences.en: It's all of a piece, and the candidates and the networks have a similar incentive to getting to the same point.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是一脉相承的，候选人和电视网在达成同一目标方面有着相似的动机。

sentences.en: You owe them an apology.
sentences.zh: 你欠他们一个道歉。

sentences.en: It feels like these changes that you're describing have all sort of converged to narrow the possible field of eligible presidential candidates.
sentences.zh: 感觉你所描述的这些变化，似乎都汇聚在一起，缩小了合格总统候选人的可能范围。

sentences.en: They have all but guaranteed that the only way to stay in the game is to be Washington-based, nationally known, somebody who's good at delivering buzzy 30-second soundbites on TV,
sentences.zh: 它们几乎保证了想要留在竞争中，唯一的办法就是以华盛顿为基地，全国闻名，并且擅长在电视上发表引人注目的30秒短评，

sentences.en: that it's all been impossible to stay in the race unless you are all these things.
sentences.zh: 除非你具备所有这些条件，否则根本不可能留在竞选中。

sentences.en: The candidates who are all of those things have such a significant advantage in the 2020 presidential contest that it's almost incalculable.
sentences.zh: 在2020年总统竞选中，具备所有这些条件的候选人拥有巨大的优势，这种优势几乎无法估量。

sentences.en: If you're not all three of those things, it's very difficult to be taken seriously as a first-tier contender for the president of the United States in the year 2019,
sentences.zh: 如果你不具备这三点，在2019年想要被认真视为美国总统的一线竞争者是非常困难的，

sentences.en: which is why of all of the candidates running, we've only seen one person in this race, Pete Buttigieg, who did not have all of those characteristics when he entered the race,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么在所有参选人中，我们只看到这场竞选中有一个人，皮特·布蒂吉格，他在加入竞选时并不具备所有这些特征，

sentences.en: add them while he was a candidate.
sentences.zh: 而是在他成为候选人期间才补齐的。

sentences.en: He is the exception that proves the rule in this cycle.
sentences.zh: 他是这个周期中证明规则的例外。

sentences.en: Most of them are just not going to have a breakthrough because the system is not built for it.
sentences.zh: 他们中的大多数人注定无法取得突破，因为这个系统并非为此而建。

sentences.en: The system is built for to funnel attention and resources towards the top tier of a half-dozen or so candidates.
sentences.zh: 这个系统的建立是为了将注意力和资源集中在少数几位顶尖候选人身上。

sentences.en: And if you're outside that group, it's very, very hard to be taken seriously.
sentences.zh: 如果你不在那个群体之内，想要被认真对待就非常、非常困难。

sentences.en: Reid, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 里德，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: After the break, here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，还有这些是你今天需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: On Thursday, President Trump once again escalated his trade war with China, saying he would impose a 10% tariff on an additional $300 billion worth of Chinese imports.
sentences.zh: 周四，特朗普总统再次升级了与中国的贸易战，称将对额外3000亿美元的中国进口商品征收10%的关税。

sentences.en: The move was punishment, the president said, for China failing to keep a promise to buy more American agricultural products.
sentences.zh: 总统表示，此举是对中国未能履行购买更多美国农产品承诺的惩罚。

sentences.en: The tariffs mean that a quick trade deal is now unlikely and that China and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这些关税意味着快速达成贸易协议的可能性现在很小，而且中国和美国

sentences.en: are likely to remain locked in a trade dispute for months, if not years.
sentences.zh: 很可能会在未来几个月，甚至几年内陷入贸易争端。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: So what was it that made this final decision for you to support an impeachment inquiry?
sentences.zh: 那么，是什么让你最终决定支持弹劾调查的呢？

sentences.en: It was a conversation that I had with Nadler, the chair of the Judiciary Committee.
sentences.zh: 那是我与司法委员会主席纳德勒进行的一次谈话。

sentences.en: The Times reports that in the week since Robert Mueller's testimony, a dozen more House Democrats have declared their support for an impeachment inquiry
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，在罗伯特·穆勒作证后的一周内，又有十几位众议院民主党人宣布支持对

sentences.en: into President Trump, including Representative Emanuel Cleaver of Missouri.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统进行弹劾调查，其中包括来自密苏里州的众议员伊曼纽尔·克利弗。

sentences.en: I think everybody realizes that Mueller has said repeatedly since the report that he didn't clear the president.
sentences.zh: 我认为每个人都意识到，穆勒在报告发布后多次表示，他并没有为总统开脱。

sentences.en: And we need to make sure that we constitutionally carry out our responsibility, which is to provide oversight to the executive branch of the government.
sentences.zh: 我们需要确保在宪法框架下履行我们的职责，即对政府行政部门进行监督。

sentences.en: As of now, 116 House Democrats support impeachment, more than half the number needed to open an inquiry.
sentences.zh: 截至目前，已有116位众议院民主党人支持弹劾，超过了开启调查所需人数的一半。

sentences.en: Despite the open reluctance of House Democratic leaders to move ahead with impeachment.
sentences.zh: 尽管众议院民主党领导层对推进弹劾持公开的抵触态度。

sentences.en: The president hasn't cooperated.
sentences.zh: 总统没有配合。

sentences.en: That also bothered me a lot.
sentences.zh: 这也让我非常困扰。

sentences.en: He's the only president in U.S.
sentences.zh: 他是美国历史上唯一一位

sentences.en: history who would not cooperate by sending his cabinet members to the committee.
sentences.zh: 拒绝通过派遣内阁成员到委员会配合调查的总统。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场残酷、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和萨拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《地铁》节目中，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。
